notes.title: 1.4 patch
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33633857/8deaf4710b119a612fad85f1cc38d741eea6d6ec.png

Sorry for the long wait, this patch was kinda big.
- Yasmine, a new character, was added to the game
- Setup screen that lets you set up a time, ending, and punishment options (you can even completely switch it off)
- Many QoL changes (separate moan/laugh sound settings, typo fixes thanks to a certain helpful fan, and such)


This is the last big patch to Fap Queen 1, since I am already planning the second part. That'll have its own announcement, I am just hinting a bit :D

notes.title: Small bugfix
notes.notes:
The current update is just a small bugfix patch, nothing serious. (for example you can't ask for mercy during the introduction, messing up the scripting a bit)  
More content (graphical too) is coming in the future though :D Hard to say when, as getting new art is a time-consuming process.

notes.title: Near release!
notes.notes: Fap Queen 1.2 (that includes the Succubus mistress!) will be released at Friday. I hope you will like it :D
